geeklist.title: Maybe Movin' Just-In-Case Auction with Freebies!, Ships from 94523, Ends 12/5/25
geeklist.description:
The owner of our rented house passed in October, so now we anticipate the inheritors of the property to send us packing next year. So, this is a larger than usual auction for me as I trim the down to the bare essential 700 or 800 games I can't live without! 🙂 I will need to do more to hit those ambitious targets! 63 items in this auction if I include the freebies. Yes! Freebies!
Here are the rules:
[b]Timing[/b] - The auction will end Friday, December 5th, sometime in the evening PST.
[b]Domestic Shipping[/b] - I will charge shipping once I determine the price after boxing up your purchases. I will be shipping from 94523 (Pleasant Hill, CA). I use Pirate Ship and usually get the cheapest option (USPS or UPS). Both options come with $100 of insurance these days. I'm willing to work with you if you can get a cheaper shipping rate than I can or if you want to request a certain method/carrier or better insurance.
[b]International Shipping[/b] - Since the buyer assumes all costs of shipping, I am willing to ship anywhere internationally by USPS, but only for purchases totaling $50 or more. ...and shipping international is QUITE expensive.
[b]Local Pickup[/b] - I'd be happy to arrange a local exchange in the East Bay of the San Francisco Bay Area in the triangle of Dublin-Oakland-Martinez. I also work 2 days a week in Embarcadero One in San Francisco and am willing to do an exchange within a few blocks of where I work.
[b]Bidding[/b] - Bids below the starting price will not be considered. Bids must be in whole dollar amounts.
[b]Condition[/b] - I will describe the edition when there is more than one and there are differences in production. If no condition is listed, consider it to be very good with no visible flaws. I can say that all items come from a smoke-free, pet-free home and are well taken care of when they get here. I do a lot of trading and sometimes purchase ding-and-dent, so I have games in all conditions. Please read the notes carefully and ask any questions you might have. All games are English editions unless otherwise stated. [i]Sometimes I throw out inserts and foreign-language rules and forget to mention these things (or forget if they were there in the first place). If you care about this, ask. If I'm putting expansions in the main box, the insert sometimes has to go.[/i]
[b]Payment[/b] - I prefer payment by Paypal, but I can accept cash-on-delivery if the sale is local. Other options can be discussed.
Here is a summary of the process: - I will contact you soon after the auction to confirm shipping address. If you provide your zip in your bid we skip this step. - I package your winnings, get a shipping quote, and send you instructions on how to pay, solicit your full address if still needed, and the total amount. - You pay. I ship. - BGG gets 3%.
[b]FREEBIES[/b] - For this auction, I have 13 items (listed on item 50) that I have designated as bonus items for purchases over a certain amount. Here's how it works.
1) [b]For EVERY BIN of at least $30[/b] - You can claim a free game by [b]commenting on Item 50[/b] by declaring your BIN item and freebie you want. First come, first served. If you comment on your bid what you want, but not on item 50, I can't guarantee you will get what you want as I may not reconcile the request before someone else comments correctly on item 50 for the same item.
2) [b]For collective BINs at least $50 OR MORE[/b] - a few items have a high BIN number, many items have BINs for less than $30. For every $50 of BIN amount you can claim a free game. For example, if you BIN Call of the Wild for $200, you can claim 4 freebies to go with it. If you BIN 3 games at $20, you can claim one freebie. Again, comment as above on item 50 to claim your freebies.
3) For spending [b]$50 or more without qualifying BINS[/b] - At the end of the auction, I will offer the available freebies to anyone spending over $50 who did not have a qualifying BIN. If there are multiple people, I will offer games in the order of the earliest winning bids. I will offer a game for every $50 of spend while supplies last. No need to comment on item 50 for this one. I will reach out to you if you qualify.
Geekmail me with additional questions or post a comment.
